registered_mechanism: Only author BerPo sampled ordered pairdot primitive
budget_interpretation: cap sensitivity with unchanged patience; actual epochs and full cost reported. No equal wall-clock quality claim.
harness_gate: functional and integration audit pass plus original/mirror smoke cover, initial/best embedding and training-loss trace equality; no original frozen file modified
cost: complete outer process pipeline including import, every pair unique/CSR/inverse, training/model selection/decode/checkpoints. No profile-derived latency claims.
failure_denominator: retain all planned jobs and missing quality; candidates cannot have additional incomplete/invalid tasks relative to their matched elementwise control for any successful claim; no timeout completion imputation

quality_thresholds.regression_reporting: list every macro/micro material decline and at-least-two-correct-recall decline; any material decline precludes pointwise/no-regression domination language

speed_thresholds.preregistered_limited_signal_scope: n5000 only allowed if all three seeds there pass speed and both-size quality gates; still run/report all n1000 and freeze same one global backend
speed_thresholds.CSR_specific_attribution: requires additional >=10% median complete saving relative to matched BMM in claimed size scope for each seed; otherwise cannot attribute unique benefit to CSR

one_global_backend_selection.quality_eligible: both n1000 and n5000 for each algorithm seed pass macro/micro mean quality and status gates
one_global_backend_selection.selection_metric: median paired saving vs elementwise over all 72 planned pairs with complete denominator
one_global_backend_selection.close_backend_simplification: If BMM is eligible and CSR is fastest but lacks CSR-specific >=10% paired cost advantage in claimed scope, freeze the qualifying BMM if it passes the speed signal. Otherwise disclose lack of CSR-specific advantage without calling CSR unique.

confirmation: Only stable development signal after all three seeds. Freeze one backend/config and strongest relevant old controls; graphs211/212, algorithm173/174/175; both sizes retained; define alternative generator and degree-only negative before reading their candidate results. Never retune after independent confirmation.
inference_policy: no case_id/n/true overlap/label/quality branch for backend/parameters; known K scalar disclosed, labels offline only
statistics: descriptive predeclared practical criteria, not IID confidence intervals, p values or statistical noninferiority theorem
supervisor_review: work/setup/candidate_design_review/; complete before development performance/quality execution
